_README: ChiDeals MCP Server Configuration v5 — Dual API + --autoConnect + Soft Navigation
_changelog: v5: Updated from Gemini fact-check (Feb 2026). Added --autoConnect to chrome-devtools setup. Documented Dual API (Declarative+Imperative). Added soft navigation notes. All package names verified against npm/GitHub.

google-maps._purpose: PRIMARY: Venue discovery + enrichment. search_nearby, get_place_details, geocode, distance_matrix.

google-maps-code-assist._purpose: RAG over Google Maps Platform docs for dev questions. No API key needed.

chrome-devtools._purpose: Google's OFFICIAL Chrome DevTools MCP (v0.17.0, 26 tools). Use --autoConnect to attach to running Chrome instance (Chrome 144+, requires chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging). Use for scraping JS-heavy restaurant sites and WebMCP testing via evaluate_script.

_key_flags.--autoConnect / --auto-connect: Attach to running Chrome (Chrome 144+). Both camelCase and kebab-case accepted. Requires chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging enabled.
_key_flags.--channel: stable|canary|beta|dev — target a specific Chrome channel
_key_flags.--browser-url: Connect via remote debugging port (e.g., http://127.0.0.1:9222). Needed for sandboxed/WSL environments.
_key_flags.--isolated: Use temporary user-data-dir, cleaned up on close

chrome-devtools._autoConnect_note: Both --autoConnect (camelCase) and --auto-connect (kebab-case) are accepted. Google's canonical examples use --autoConnect. This flag is ADDITIVE to --browser-url, not a replacement. Use --browser-url for WSL/sandboxed environments.
chrome-devtools._requirements: Node.js v20.19+, Chrome stable or newer

chrome-devtools-webmcp._purpose: MCP-B FORK with dedicated WebMCP tool discovery/execution. Adds list_webmcp_tools + call_webmcp_tool. Use for TESTING our WebMCP tools. Uses --browser-url for WSL compatibility.
_extra_tools: list_webmcp_tools — Discover all navigator.modelContext tools registered on current page
call_webmcp_tool — Execute a WebMCP tool by name with params

firecrawl._purpose: Web scraping + structured extraction. Restaurant sites, menu pages.

sqlite._purpose: Direct database access — query/insert deals, analytics, WebMCP analytics table.

filesystem._purpose: Read/write project files, scraper configs, seed data, exports.

github._purpose: Repo management, issue tracking for stale deals.

brave-search._purpose: Web search for new venue discovery, deal announcements.

claude_code_add_all: claude mcp add chrome-devtools --scope user npx chrome-devtools-mcp@latest --autoConnect
claude mcp add firecrawl -- npx -y firecrawl-mcp

_webmcp_testing_workflow.description: How to test ChiDeals WebMCP tools using @mcp-b/chrome-devtools-mcp
_webmcp_testing_workflow.prerequisite: @mcp-b/global polyfill loaded on page (already in package.json). Chrome 146+ with WebMCP flag OR any Chrome with @mcp-b/global polyfill.
_webmcp_testing_workflow.native_detection: index.js checks for native navigator.modelContext first (Chrome 146+), then falls back to @mcp-b/global polyfill. See CLAUDE.md Section 8.
steps: 1. Start Chrome with remote debugging: chrome --remote-debugging-port=9222
7. Check analytics: SELECT * FROM webmcp_analytics ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10

_dual_api_note.description: Feb 2026 Chrome blog confirms two registration paths
_dual_api_note.declarative: Form-based tools (search, nearby, venue, submit) get HTML attributes for agent discovery. Fast path — no JS needed for discovery.
_dual_api_note.imperative: Complex tools (crawl planner, neighborhood summary) use navigator.modelContext.registerTool(). Full power — custom logic, multi-step handlers.
_dual_api_note.our_strategy: 4 tools get BOTH paths, 4 tools stay imperative-only. See webmcp_tools.js registrationType field.
